name: Eero Mäkinen
bio:
Eero's analytical mind and meticulous nature were evident from a young age. He excelled in mathematics and finance during his schooling, leading him to pursue a degree in accounting. Motorsport piqued his interest during a summer internship at a local rally team, where he witnessed firsthand the complex financial structures that underpinned the sport. He found the blend of high-stakes competition and intricate accounting incredibly appealing.

After graduation, Eero gained experience at a corporate firm, honing his skills in financial analysis and reporting. However, his passion for motorsport remained strong, prompting him to seek a role in the industry. His methodical approach to budgeting and cost control, combined with his deep understanding of financial regulations, makes him a valuable asset to Herberth Motorsport. He is driven by a desire to optimize team resources and ensure long-term financial stability.

What sets Eero apart is his ability to see the bigger picture. He's not just crunching numbers; he's actively seeking ways to improve financial efficiency and contribute to the team's overall success. Eero's perfectionism ensures accuracy in all his work, and he's constantly looking for ways to improve the team's financial practices.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight quiff.
physical.description: Eero is of average height and build, with sharp, intelligent features.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with financial projections.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the desk when deep in thought.
